scope.summary: Implement StudioComponentInstance (hsk.studio.component_instance@1) as a live reference to a StudioComponent (renders the current definition plus its own local overrides, never a copy) and the typed insert/place command used by model lanes (typed-insert) and the asset browser (drag-insert, MT-328). Instance re-renders when the main component definition changes except on locally overridden surfaces (MT-339).
acceptance_criteria: StudioComponentInstance is a live reference with typed placement; re-renders on definition change; not a copy
expected_tests: live: placing an instance emits ledger event + authority row; editing the main component re-renders the instance (live reference, not copy)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No instance model; components cannot be reused; design system is inert.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
